These are three arcade cores - Gyruss, Time Pilot '84 and Galaga. You must provide ROM files in folders on the SD card (NOT ZIPPED - UNZIP THEM). 

- Gyruss supports MAME sets "GYRUSS" and "GYRUSSCE".
- Time Pilot 84 supports "TP84" and "TP84A".
- Galaga supports "GALAGA", "GALAGAO" and "GALAGAMW".

All three arcade games are normally vertical - you can rotate them for a horizontal monitor by pressing 0, or one of the shoulder buttons on a SNES pad.

Look in each folder for more details.

If you only care about running the cores, you only need to keep the .PHX files. Everything else is source code.
